$comment: Provider presets. Checked against official docs on 2026-10-06. Every entry lists what was verified; 'unverified' items must be confirmed before the provider is marked recommended. Model IDs here are suggestions shown in the panel, users can type any model. Every provider must read images: stills review, style matching, the speaker's position and the user's own images all need vision, so text-only models are not offered. OpenRouter came back on 2026-10-08 with that filter: its model list says which models take images. keyUrl: where the editor creates a key (checked 2026-10-08 against platform.claude.com/docs/en/get-api-key, platform.openai.com, ai.google.dev, platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/quickstart and the Model Studio docs). Qwen was removed on 2026-10-08: its key is bound to a region and its address to a workspace id, too much setup for an editor.

providers.verified: SDK and model IDs from the claude-api reference bundled with Claude Code, 2026-09-25; claude-fable-5-1 (10/50 USD per MTok, adaptive thinking only, refusal fallbacks) added from the same reference, 2026-10-28
model names and context from developers.openai.com/api/docs/models
unverified: OpenAI recommends the Responses API for new projects; whether GPT-6 models work on Chat Completions and whether max_completion_tokens replaces max_tokens is unverified. A dedicated OpenAIAdapter on the Responses API is planned (M1b).

notes: the Grok CLI plan (Grok Build) is a separate subscription from API credits

providers.verified: platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api, text-anthropic-api, guides/models-intro; the connection test's red square read by MiniMax-M3 through chat/completions with a real key (1.4 s), 2026-10-08

providers.verified: docs.z.ai/api-reference/llm/chat-completion (base URL, Bearer key, reasoning_effort low/high/max for the vision models, default max), docs.z.ai/guides/vlm/glm-5.3-flash (model ids, image_url input), docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing, checked 2026-10-15
notes: whiteboard benchmark through Z.ai (15 Oct 2026): low thinking finished in 1.8 min for about $0.01 with no repair; high took 16.5 min and failed its checks (an overlay left a faint layer three times); Z.ai's own default (max) took 18 to 28 min
glm-5.3 itself reads no images and is left out
Z.ai's GLM Coding Plan is for its listed coding tools only: Kilnframe uses an API key

providers.verified: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (public, 467 models, 297 with "image" in architecture.input_modalities; the suggested models are among them), openrouter.ai/docs/faq (5.5% fee on buying credits, no markup on model prices), checked 2026-10-08
notes: one key for many providers; only models that take images are offered
OpenRouter takes 5.5% (at least $0.80) when credits are bought; model prices are passed through

suggested models each saw the red-square test with a real key (2026-10-08); minimax/minimax-m3 left out of the suggestions because OpenRouter routes it across 13 hosts and one (StreamLake) misread the square, it stays reachable under All Models

reasoningEffort: GLM 5.3 Flash thought until it hit the 64k output limit on a whiteboard scene (11 Oct 2026); "medium" leaves about half of the limit to the answer (openrouter.ai/docs/use-cases/reasoning-tokens)

z-ai/glm-5.3-flash suggested since 13 Oct 2026: a whiteboard benchmark run finished in 2.3 min for about $0.01 with the medium setting; its details are weaker than the others, so the site marks it experimental
